# Chinook (vendored) — open-source sample database

`Chinook_Sqlite.sql` — the **Chinook** sample database (a digital media store:
artists, albums, tracks, customers, invoices, employees, playlists). Created by
**Luis Rocha** as a multi-database **open-source alternative/successor to
Microsoft's Northwind** sample. 11 related tables (~3,500 tracks), ideal for
demonstrating SQL joins/views.

- Source: <https://github.com/lerocha/chinook-database> (v1.4.5, `Chinook_Sqlite.sql`)
- Author: Luis Rocha
- License: MIT-style permissive (see `LICENSE.md`)

Loaded on demand by the edot data workspace (**🎵 Sample (Chinook)**), which
runs this script into the in-browser SQLite engine.
